digest: Mapped stop, cancellation, and terminal-summary implementations; no unit tests are present, and store/types dependencies are omitted.

implementationMap.evidence: launchStopRequested checks registered signals by workflowRunPath; check() reads readWorkflowStopIntent; throwIfWorkflowStopRequested reads the same intent.
implementationMap.observedBehavior: Both stop sources are wired. Monitoring catches disk-read errors, while throwIfWorkflowStopRequested does not. pollMs defaults to 200 and is clamped to 1. dispose only clears the interval.

implementationMap.evidence: createWorkflowStopRequestedError sets name WorkflowStopRequested and message workflow stop requested for <runId>.
implementationMap.observedBehavior: Abort reasons use the specified name/message. isWorkflowStopRequestedError also accepts any Error whose message starts with workflow stop requested.

implementationMap.evidence: Candidate strings are checked at lines 19-21; content text is JSON.parsed and recursively passed back at lines 23-29.
implementationMap.observedBehavior: Recognizes the three specified strings but also cancelled, timeout, cancelled flags, and AbortError-shaped values. The parsed !== value guard does not prevent repeated equivalent JSON recursion.

implementationMap.evidence: completed with run.degradation maps to completed_degraded; direct-dynamic control-read failure falls through to completed_without_semantic_result.
implementationMap.observedBehavior: The requested semantic-status branches are implemented, alongside dynamic control status branches.

implementationMap.evidence: outputRetryAttempts sums task.outputRetry.attempts; launch retry sum is returned under launchRetries.
implementationMap.observedBehavior: Both retry values are summed across tasks, but the public launch field is named launchRetries rather than launchRetryAttempts.

implementationMap.evidence: The only script is typecheck; tracked files contain no test directory or unit-test files.
implementationMap.observedBehavior: No implementation evidence for per-requirement unit tests is present.

unmappedAreas: Q1 unit tests for S1-S7, C1-C2, and T1-T3 are absent.
store.js and types.js are imported by src but intentionally omitted, so dependency behavior cannot be inspected.
notes: This stage maps observed implementation evidence only; it does not issue final conformance judgments.
SPEC.md is the sole declared upstream requirement source; no workflow artifacts were available.
